title.ja: 図1-1 角換わりの基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form of Bishop Exchange

explain.ja: 図1-1は角換わりの基本形です。この局面から角換わり早繰り銀の形を目指します。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is the basic form of Bishop Exchange. From this position, aim for the Bishop Exchange Fast-Moving Silver formation.

title.ja: 図1-2 ▲4六銀とするのが早繰り銀
title.en: Figure 1-2: ▲4六銀 is Rapid Advancing Silver

explain.ja: ▲3六歩と突き、銀を3七から4六へと進めていくのが早繰り銀の陣形です。この形からどう攻めていくかを見ます。
explain.en: Pushing ▲3六歩 and moving the silver from 3七 to 4六 is the Fast-Moving Silver formation. We see how to attack from this form.

section.ja: 銀を3七~4六と使うのが早繰り銀
section.en: Using the silver on 3七 then 4六 is Rapid Advancing Silver

line.text: ▲3六歩、△6四歩、▲3七銀、△6三銀、▲2五歩、△3三銀、▲4六銀

title.en: Figure 2-1: Open the attack with ▲3五歩

explain.ja: 早繰り銀の基本の仕掛けは、▲3五歩と3筋の歩をぶつける手です。さらに進めて攻め筋を見ます。
explain.en: The basic attack of Fast-Moving Silver is to confront with the 3rd-file pawn by ▲3五歩. Continue to see the attacking lines.

title.ja: 図2-2 銀が五段目に進出
title.en: Figure 2-2: The silver advances to the fifth rank

explain.ja: 3五の歩を交換しながら、銀を五段目に進出させるのが攻めの狙いです。ここからさらに追撃します。
explain.en: The aim is to exchange the pawn on 3五 while advancing the silver to the fifth rank. Then press the attack further.

section.ja: 棒銀のように銀交換を狙う
section.en: Aim for a silver exchange like Rushing Silver

title.ja: 図2-3 銀取りに構わず▲2四歩と攻める
title.en: Figure 2-3: Ignore the silver threat and attack with ▲2四歩

explain.ja: 相手は△3四歩と打って銀を追い返そうとしますが、銀取りに構わず▲2四歩と突いて攻める手が成立します。次に△3五歩と銀を取られても、▲2三歩成の攻めが強烈です。銀を五段目に出して銀取りに構わず▲2四歩と突く攻め筋は、棒銀と似ています。
explain.en: The opponent drops △3四歩 to drive the silver back, but Black can ignore the threat to the silver and push ▲2四歩. Even if the silver is then captured by △3五歩, the attack ▲2三歩成 is powerful. This attack, bringing the silver to the fifth rank and pushing ▲2四歩 despite the silver being threatened, resembles Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 棒銀のように銀交換を狙う
section.en: Aim for a silver exchange like Rushing Silver

title.ja: 図2-4 銀交換が基本の狙い
title.en: Figure 2-4: Silver exchange is the basic aim

explain.ja: 相手の守りの銀と攻めの銀を交換できれば、早繰り銀の攻めは成功と言えます。ここから、1筋の歩を突き捨てて▲1三歩と打つ端攻めなどの攻め手があります。ここから先の攻め筋も棒銀と似ています。
explain.en: If Black can exchange the attacking silver for the opponent's defending silver, the Fast-Moving Silver attack can be called successful. From here there are attacks such as an edge attack: sacrificing the 1st-file pawn and dropping ▲1三歩. The attacking lines from here also resemble Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 銀交換できれば早繰り銀優勢
section.en: If silvers can be exchanged, Rapid Advancing Silver is better

line.text: △2四歩、▲同銀、△同銀、▲同飛、△2三歩、▲2八飛

title.ja: 図3-1 居玉のまま攻めると？
title.en: Figure 3-1: What if attacking with the king unmoved?

explain.ja: 図1-2に戻り、早繰り銀の失敗パターンを見ます。先ほどの攻めとほとんど同じ形に見えますが、玉が居玉のまま攻めると思わぬ落とし穴があります。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 1-2 and see a failing pattern for Fast-Moving Silver. It looks almost the same as the earlier attack, but attacking with the king still on its starting square (i-gyoku) has an unexpected pitfall.

section.en: Attacking with the king at home is bad

title.ja: 図3-2 攻めが好調に見えるが…？
title.en: Figure 3-2: The attack looks good, but...?

explain.ja: 先ほどと同じ手順で、攻めの銀と守りの銀を交換しました。一見、早繰り銀が気持ちよく攻めていますが、ここで相手に反撃の一手があります。
explain.en: With the same sequence, the attacking silver and the defending silver were exchanged. Fast-Moving Silver seems to be attacking well, but the opponent has a counterattacking move here.

section.ja: 王手飛車の反撃で敗勢に
section.en: A check-and-rook fork counterattack turns the game into a loss

line.text: △3五歩、▲同銀、△3四歩、▲2四歩、△同歩、▲同銀、△同銀、▲同飛

title.ja: 図3-3 王手飛車で敗着
title.en: Figure 3-3: Fatal move: check that forks the king and rook

explain.ja: △1五角が王手飛車になって敗着です。早繰り銀では3筋の歩を突いていくため、このような角打ちの隙が生じやすくなっています。この王手飛車を避けるため、あらかじめ玉を6八などに寄せてから攻めるのが安全です。また▲1六歩と端の歩を突いておいて△1五角の筋を消す手もよく指されます。
explain.en: △1五角 is a double attack on king and rook and decides the game. Since Fast-Moving Silver pushes the 3rd-file pawn, such bishop-drop weaknesses arise easily. To avoid this, it is safe to move the king to something like 6八 before attacking. Pushing the edge pawn ▲1六歩 beforehand to remove the △1五角 line is also often played.

section.ja: 王手飛車の反撃で敗勢に
section.en: A check-and-rook fork counterattack turns the game into a loss

title.ja: 図4-1 相手の攻めの狙いは？
title.en: Figure 4-1: What is the opponent's attack aiming at?

explain.ja: 図2-2に戻り、相手が反撃してくる順を見ます。先ほどは△3四歩と打ってきましたが、銀取りを無視して▲2四歩と攻めれば早繰り銀が優勢でした。今度は△3四歩に代わって△8六歩と相手も攻めてきます。これに▲同銀と取ると、△5五角で飛車香両取りになるので注意が必要です。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 2-2 and see the lines where the opponent counterattacks. Before, White dropped △3四歩, and ignoring the threat to the silver with ▲2四歩 favored Fast-Moving Silver. Now instead of △3四歩, White attacks with △8六歩. If Black takes with ▲同銀, △5五角 forks rook and lance, so be careful.

section.ja: 銀が五段目に出たタイミングは注意
section.en: Be careful of the timing when the silver reaches the fifth rank

explain.ja: ▲同歩と歩を取ると、相手はさらに△8五歩と継ぎ歩の手筋を使ってきました。この狙いは何でしょうか。まず素直に▲同歩と取るとどうなるか見ます。
explain.en: If Black takes with ▲同歩, the opponent uses the successive-pawn tesuji with another △8五歩. What is the aim? First see what happens if Black simply takes with ▲同歩.

section.en: What is the aim of the △8五歩 connecting pawn?

title.ja: 図4-3 銀桂両取りの十字飛車
title.en: Figure 4-3: Cross-shaped rook forking silver and knight

explain.ja: △8五歩に▲同歩と取ると、△同飛が銀桂両取りの十字飛車になります。これで早繰り銀側が劣勢になります。
explain.en: If Black takes △8五歩 with ▲同歩, △同飛 becomes a cross-fork of rook attacking silver and knight. The Fast-Moving Silver side then falls behind.

section.ja: ▲同歩と取ると銀桂両取りの十字飛車
section.en: Capturing with ▲ pawn allows a cross-shaped rook fork on silver and knight

title.ja: 図4-4 こちらも攻め合う

explain.ja: △8五歩に▲同歩と取ると失敗なので、図4-2に戻って別の手を考えます。ここでは▲3四歩と攻め合いましょう。△8六歩と歩を取り込まれても、▲8八歩と打てばすぐには相手の攻めがないので、ここは相手の攻めを無視するのが良い手になります。
explain.en: Taking △8五歩 with ▲同歩 fails, so return to Diagram 4-2 and consider another move. Here race with ▲3四歩. Even if White takes the pawn with △8六歩, dropping ▲8八歩 leaves White without an immediate attack, so ignoring the opponent's attack is the good move.

section.ja: 継ぎ歩を手抜いて▲3四歩で攻め合う
section.en: Ignore the tsugi-fu and counterattack with ▲3四歩

title.ja: 図4-5 早繰り銀側が指しやすい
title.en: Figure 4-5: Rapid Advancing Silver side has the easier game

explain.ja: 図4-5の局面では、早繰り銀側の銀が相手玉の近くまで迫っています。ここから持ち駒の角と歩でうまく攻めをつなげられるかが勝負のカギです。
explain.en: In Diagram 4-5 the Fast-Moving Silver side's silver is close to the opponent's king. The key is whether the attack can be connected skillfully with the bishop and pawn in hand.

section.ja: 継ぎ歩を手抜いて▲3四歩で攻め合う
section.en: Ignore the tsugi-fu and counterattack with ▲3四歩
